title: Inspire Science: Integrated, Grade 8 (Write-In Student Edition, Units 1-4)
edition: 2020 (copyright 2020 on publisher pages for the series; ISBN records say 2019)

sources.what: publisher scope and sequence (units, modules, lessons)

summary: An NGSS-built integrated middle-school science course in four write-in unit books organised into modules and 5E lessons. Grade 8 covers geologic time and evolution, forces, energy and electromagnetism, waves and light with information technology, and human activity plus the Earth-Moon-Sun system and the universe.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: Change Over Time
toc.covers: Reading Earth's history in rocks and fossils and how populations change by natural selection.

children.label: Module
children.title: Geologic Time
children.covers: Dating rocks and fossils and organising Earth's history into a time scale.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Analyzing the Rock and Fossil Records
children.covers: Superposition, relative and absolute dating, and what fossils show about past life.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Building a Time Line
children.covers: The geologic time scale with its eons, eras, and major events such as mass extinctions.

children.label: Module
children.title: Natural Selection and Adaptations
children.covers: How variation and selection change traits in populations.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: How Traits Change
children.covers: Genetic variation and mutations and how they affect traits.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: The Theory of Evolution by Natural Selection
children.covers: Darwin's observations, overproduction, variation, and adaptation.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Artificial Selection
children.covers: Selective breeding and genetic engineering by humans.

children.label: Module
children.title: Evidence of Evolution
children.covers: Fossil and biological evidence for common ancestry.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Fossil Evidence of Evolution
children.covers: Patterns in the fossil record and transitional forms.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Biological Evidence of Evolution
children.covers: Comparative anatomy, homologous structures, embryology, and molecular comparisons.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.title: Energy and Motion
toc.covers: Forces and motion, kinetic and potential energy, and electric and magnetic forces.

children.label: Module
children.title: Forces and Motion
children.covers: Describing motion and Newton's laws, including gravity.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Position and Motion
children.covers: Reference points, speed, velocity, and distance-time graphs.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Force and Acceleration
children.covers: Balanced and unbalanced forces and Newton's first and second laws.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Force Pairs
children.covers: Newton's third law and action-reaction pairs in collisions.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Gravitational Force
children.covers: How mass and distance set the strength of gravity.

children.label: Module
children.title: Mechanical Energy
children.covers: Kinetic and potential energy and the conservation of energy.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Kinetic Energy
children.covers: How mass and speed determine kinetic energy.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Potential Energy
children.covers: Gravitational, elastic, and other stored energy that depends on position.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Conservation of Energy
children.covers: Energy transformations and transfers in a system.

children.label: Module
children.title: Electromagnetic Forces
children.covers: Magnetic and electric forces, circuits, and electromagnets.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Magnetic Forces
children.covers: Magnets, magnetic fields, and factors that affect magnetic force.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Electric Forces
children.covers: Electric charge, attraction and repulsion, and electric fields.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Simple Circuits
children.covers: Current, voltage, resistance, and series and parallel circuits.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Electromagnetism
children.covers: Electromagnets, motors, and generators.

toc.label: Unit 3
toc.title: Understanding Waves
toc.covers: Wave properties, light and optics, and how signals carry information.

children.label: Module
children.title: Introduction to Waves
children.covers: Mechanical and electromagnetic waves and how they behave.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Wave Properties
children.covers: Amplitude, wavelength, frequency, and the energy waves carry.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Mechanical Wave Interactions
children.covers: Reflection, absorption, transmission, and interference of sound and water waves.

children.label: Module
children.title: Light
children.covers: How light travels and interacts with matter.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: How Light Travels
children.covers: Light as an electromagnetic wave and the electromagnetic spectrum.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Light Reflection and Mirrors
children.covers: The law of reflection and plane and curved mirrors.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Light Refraction and Lenses
children.covers: Refraction, convex and concave lenses, and the eye.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Color of Light
children.covers: Why objects appear coloured: absorption, reflection, and mixing of light.

children.label: Module
children.title: Information Technologies
children.covers: How waves are used to encode and send information.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Communicating with Signals
children.covers: Analog signals and how waves carry information.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Modern Communication with Digital Signals
children.covers: Digital and binary signals and why they are more reliable than analog.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.title: Humans and Their Place in the Universe
toc.covers: Human population and environmental impact, the Sun-Earth-Moon system, and gravity's role in the solar system and universe.

children.label: Module
children.title: Earth and Human Activity
children.covers: Population growth, resource use, and reducing human impact.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Human Population Trends
children.covers: Growth of the human population and per-capita resource consumption.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: People and the Environment
children.covers: Monitoring and minimising human effects on Earth's systems.

children.label: Module
children.title: The Sun-Earth-Moon System
children.covers: Earth's orbit and tilt, the Moon's phases, and eclipses.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Earth's Motion Around the Sun
children.covers: Rotation, revolution, axial tilt, and the seasons.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Lunar Phases
children.covers: Why the Moon's visible shape changes over a month.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Eclipses
children.covers: Solar and lunar eclipses and the alignments that cause them.

children.label: Module
children.title: Exploring the Universe
children.covers: Gravity's role in orbits and in forming the solar system and galaxies.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Gravity and the Universe
children.covers: How gravity holds orbits and shaped stars, galaxies, and the solar system.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: The Solar System
children.covers: The planets and other bodies and the scale of the solar system.

notes: Headings are from the publisher's scope and sequence, which lists units, modules, and lessons without numbers. In that PDF the Grade 7 and Grade 8 columns are interleaved; units were assigned by column position in the layout text. Which unit books ISBNs 9780076874897 and 9780076874903 are was not confirmed. Modules nest under units and lessons under modules.
